data.body: Fixed: Added explicit Verify-Before-Assert rule to reviewer-base.md Diff-Boundary Discipline section. Reviewers must now verify file existence, file content, and behavior claims about code outside the diff before emitting any finding. Unverified claims must use the context-request protocol (standard/deep/overlay tiers) or be downgraded to minor. Critical/important findings based on unverified claims about files not in the diff are prohibited. Agent files rebuilt from updated sources.
